Page 1/5 
Machine Learning (BMI/GEO/WNA) 
Code Assignment U1A1  
Linear Regression 
This is NOT a group Assignment. 
 
10 marks 
Please complete seeing the videos for Week 1-2 before attempting this 
assignment.  
 
Use real estate valuation regression dataset : 
https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/477/real+estate+valuation+data+set  from the 
UCI repository, and use google colab to code. 
 
First, download the csv file, and open it in your computer and analyze the data. 
Try to understand what the data is about. Read through the data description 
given in the UCI website as well. 
 
Section A 
Answer the following questions [1 mark if you answer all the below 
questions]: 
1. How many samples are there? 
            Ans: 414 
2. How many input variables are there? 
X1=the transaction date 
X2=the house age (unit: year)  
X3=the distance to the nearest MRT station (unit: meter) 
X4=the number of convenience stores in the living circle on foot (integer)  
X5=the geographic coordinate, latitude. (unit: degree)  
X6=the geographic coordinate, longitude. (unit: degree) 
Ans: 6 
3. Which column is the output variable (target outcome)? 
Ans: column-Y (house price per unit area)

Page 2/5 
4.What does each of the input columns mean? 
X2=the house age (unit: year)  
X3=the distance to the nearest MRT station (unit: meter) 
X4=the number of convenience stores in the living circle on foot (integer)  
X5=the geographic coordinate, latitude. (unit: degree)  
X6=the geographic coordinate, longitude. (unit: degree) 
Ans X1=the transaction date 
 
5.Section B 
For each of the questions below, you need to put in the screenshot of the code and 
its output. You could use the sample google colab file that is provided with this 
assignment. 
 
1. Understanding the dataset [4 marks] 
There are many input variables in this dataset. Use only X1 to X4 as input 
variables, and y as the output variable. 
Using the scatter plots between each of the input features (X1-X4) and the output 
(Y), which input variable, do you think, is better in predicting the output / 
target variable? 
Ans: X2=the house age (unit: year),because visually it has clear recognizable 
pattern, so input variable has strong relationship with output variables.

Page 3/5 
2. Write code to find out how many samples are there in total in this dataset? [1 
mark] 
Ans: total 414 samples 
Code: Input   
output:

Page 4/5 
3. What is the train test split ratio that you have chosen? [1 Mark] 
Ans: the train test split ratio that I have chosen is 67:33 
4. Evaluate the linear regression model by computing the MAE, MSE and Mean 
Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) . 
(for MAPE - pls refer to the sample here - https://scikit-
learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.metrics.mean_absolute_percentage_
error.html)  
[3 marks]

Page 5/5 
5. What are the 3 new things that you learned after you completed this assignment 
? 
Ans: 1. Importance of understanding data structure i.e  each features, target 
variables  
       2. how to interpret scatter plots to identify the input variables and its 
relationship with target variable. 
      3. understood more about linear regression method to find the best fitting 
line that describes the linear rltnship btwn variables and visualizing the training 
model step for understanding the performance of a linear regression model. 
 
Grading Scheme (Total 10 Marks) 
Time - 4 hours max. 
Submission on Teams by 11.30 PM, 20 Feb 2024. 
Late submissions are NOT allowed. 
 
Plagiarism Policy 
You are NOT allowed to discuss. You cannot copy paste text/image from the 
internet or other sources. All assignments are put through TurnitIn, and any 
similarity score of more than 40% will be flagged as plagiarism. The penalties 
are as follows. 
● 1st instance of plagiarism - 0 marks for this assignment 
● 2nd instance of plagiarism - GRADE DOWN for the entire course 
● 3rd instance of plagiarism - FAIL in the course 
 
By submitting this assignment, you agree to the above policies on grading, 
submission and plagiarism.
